caption: The drawing is composed of several rectangular sections, each containing white, simplified, abstract forms on a dark, lightly textured background. In the top left section, there are multiple white line figures, including wavy and angular shapes, spiral motifs, and branching patterns. Next to it, in the middle upper section, are abstract shapes resembling animals and organic forms. The upper right section has two symbols: a four-armed, cross-like figure and an X shape, both outlined in white. The bottom two sections stretch horizontally; the left section contains five elongated, stick-like humanoid figures with various limb positions, the two central figures holding hands. The bottom right section has a bird-like form with a long neck and legs, shown in profile. The overall color scheme is monochromatic with white figures and dark gray backgrounds, separated by white borders.
title: Petroglyph - Animal
